# Ericka Nash Real Estate

> Ericka Nash is a Compass real estate broker in Sammamish, Washington, and the #1 Realtor in Sahalee Estates. She specializes in luxury and golf and country club homes on the north Sammamish plateau, including Sahalee Estates, Timberline and Heritage Hills.

## Key facts
- #1 Realtor in Sahalee Estates, Sammamish, WA; more than $85 million sold in Sahalee
- Top Producing Sahalee Realtor every year 2020-2025
- 104 homes sold, priced from $637K to $3.9M
- 5.0 Zillow rating across 17 client reviews
- RealTrends "The Thousand" 2019-2025; RealTrends top 1.5% of agents nationwide
- University of Washington graduate; background in interior design
- Serves Sammamish, Redmond, Bellevue and Issaquah, Washington
- Contact: 425-410-3865, ericka.nash@compass.com
